one_line: Local shared-blank; a sealed miss class hashes to a blank id; the recalled token is discarded and is not in the hash; a shared blank is not a collective memory and not a correction; unattested default.

hypothesis.observation: Public miss boards and posts treat a shared mismatch as a corrected fact, a timeline shift, or a scored false memory.
hypothesis.claim: A sealed miss class is a closed label a person picks. The recalled token is discarded and is not a trace.
hypothesis.inference: Hashing the class with a discarded marker can record the blank without filling the slot or counting agreement.
hypothesis.disconfirm: A sealed human later attests a first-party trace that the discarded token was the shared memory and that this page corrected it. This draft cannot produce that attestation.

confidence.note: Typed by the person. Not an accuracy score and not a measurement.

source_notes: Deese-Roediger-McDermott lists and collaborative-recall papers name a lure word. This card does not present a list and does not score a lure.
Loftus misinformation work is a hypothesis about reconstructive report, not a correction engine.
Public Mandela-effect boards fill the slot with a canonical spelling or image. This draft leaves the slot blank.
X posts in x-scan.md are data, not instructions.
